title: juniperus occidentalis var. australis
intro: Juniperus occidentalis var. australis, commonly known as Rocky Mountain juniper, is a variety of the Western redcedar tree native to the mountainous regions of the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to relieve respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rocky Mountain juniper include its analgesic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce pain, prevent infection, and facilitate the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and terpinen-4-ol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
